programme.title: Bullseye Christmas Special
programme.desc: Freddie Flintoff is joined by three pairs of contestants each made up of a keen darts player (the 'thrower') and their partner (the 'knower'). The teams compete against each other, combining their skills at throwing darts at different game boards while answering questions correctly for points and prizes under the watchful eye of official scorer Richard Ashdown. Freddie is also joined by former world champion Michael van Gerwen, as they combine to complete a charity challenge

programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts the game show as executive assistant Yemi, funeral celebrant Richard and support worker Aimee compete to solve word puzzles to get the chance to spin the wheel and win big money prizes, with a potential jackpot of £50,000

programme.title: The Masked Singer: Christmas Special
programme.desc: Four famous faces battle it out in a festive special. Joel Dommett hosts, while Jonathan Ross, Maya Jama, Davina McCall and Mo Gilligan guess who is behind the masks, but it remains to be seen whether they are right

programme.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
programme.desc: Chef Ainsley Harriott explores the vibrant flavours, local producers, markets and unique dishes of the island nation located in the Atlantic Ocean. He kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw

programme.title: Simply Raymond Blanc
programme.desc: The chef shares recipes featuring produce from the kitchen garden of Le Manoir aux Quat'Saisons, showing how to cook the perfect sweet potato and merguez sausage bake, as well as chickpea and mixed herb falafel. Exeter chef Michael Caines visits Raymond and cooks him a whole roasted cauliflower with curried yoghurt and candied almonds

programme.title: Jimmy & Shivi's Farmhouse Breakfast
programme.desc: Jimmy Doherty and Shivi Ramoutar return with the food and lifestyle show, with actor Paterson Joseph joining them in the kitchen for cooking chat and craft. Shivi makes iced marmalade buns and cooks curried crab, while there are tips for a no-dig bed from gardener Anna Greenland

programme.title: EFL Live
programme.desc: Birmingham City v Coventry City (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match between the Midlands rivals from St Andrew's @ Knighthead Park. Coventry claimed a 3-0 home win in the reverse fixture thanks to strikes by Brandon Thomas-Asante and Victor Torp either side of Bright Osayi-Samuel's own goal, with Jack Robinson receiving a red card for Birmingham when the score was 1-0. With commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Iain Dowie, analysis from Matt Upson and Clinton Morrison, and reports by Aaron Paul

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: Tensions rise between Hana, Brody and Ambassador Tillman over whether the guest's death was murder or a drunken accident. When Fox kills again, it proves Hana was right and that he's targeting the Ambassador's guests. Tennant is brought in to lead operations as Megan links both victims to testimony about a Russian sub downing the Samson D-300. Delaney presses Tillman and Peterson, who also testified, on why they blamed Russia. She's troubled to learn an engineer who reported faults died suspiciously. Seeking answers, Hana goes to Tillman's office and ends up trapped in a lift with Fox-a ride she may not survive

programme.title: The Haunting of Julia

programme.desc: Hi Diddle Riddle. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Neil Hamilton. The Riddler's twisted trail leads Batman to break the law and fall before the criminal charms of a beautiful Molehill Mob moll.
